title: PR #78: fix: remove wall-clock from blockchain determinism tests
content:
State: open
Merged: False
Draft: True

The previous RELEASE-001 determinism run reported 24 SystemTime::now findings in a-townchain storage/blockchain tests. Source inspection shows all 24 are test-only temporary-path generation. This patch replaces wall-clock-derived names with an atomic test counter, preserving unique paths without weakening the determinism gate. No consensus/runtime clock access is changed.
